title: Winnie-the-Pooh
author: A. A. Milne
summary: A small boy and his stuffed animals have mild adventures in the Hundred Acre Wood: hunting for honey, building houses, and getting lost on an expedition. Each chapter is a self-contained story.
readIf: you want a soothing read-aloud full of gentle humour and affectionate misunderstanding.
skipIf: you want plot momentum; the stories are tiny, episodic and cheerfully circular.

pairings.reason: Another timeless world of animal friends whose small crises are treated with warmth and good humour.
Shares the tenderness toward friendship between creatures, with a more emotional story arc.
A short, wistful classic that uses a childlike voice to say something grown-up.
